CITY COUNCIL OF MONTEREY PARK
  CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  NOTICE OF CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL COMMUNITY MEETING

  As a quorum of the City Council may be present for the event, this special meeting
  notice is being issued for the purpose of the Brown Act pursuant to Government
  Code Section 54956.1 Members of the City Council present will not formally
  convene as a body, nor will they take any formal action at the event.

  MEETUP WITH THE MAYOR
  FOR BUSINESSES

  NBC Seafood Restaurant
  404 S. Atlantic Blvd., Monterey Park 91754

  Thursday
  June 26, 2025
  5:00 p.m. – 6:30 p.m.

  I.  Welcome

  II.  Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn more
  about doing business in the City with the Mayor of Monterey Park.

  III.  Adjournment

  MINUTES
  MONTEREY PARK CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL COMMUNITY MEETING
  JUNE 26, 2025

The City Council of the City of Monterey Park held a Special Community Meeting of the
Council at NBC Seafood Restaurant located at 404 S. Atlantic Blvd., Monterey Park
91754 on Thursday, June 26, 2025, at 5:00 p.m.

1.  Call to Order
  City Manager Alvarez called the meeting to order at 5:20 p.m.

2.  Roll Call

  City Manager Alvarez called the roll:

  Council Members Present: Vinh Ngo,
  Council Members Absent: Jose Sanchez, Henry Lo, Thomas Wong, Elizabeth
  Yang

  Also Present: Acting City Librarian LV Frazier, Economic Development Manager
  Joseph Torres, Economic Development Specialist Janice Huang

  Meet Up with The Mayor

  I.  Welcome

  II.  Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn
  more about the City with the Mayor of Monterey Park

  III.  Adjournment

  Due to a lack of quorum, the meeting was adjourned at 5:45 p.m. by City
  Manager Alvarez.

_________________
Maychelle Yee
City Clerk

  MISSION STATEMENT
 The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth and opportunity,
  and create a joyous and collaborative environment.
  .
